messages.subject: Integrating time series graphs and leaflet maps using R shiny
parts:
Hello I posted a question about integrating time series graphs and leaflet maps in a Shiny app on StackOverflow, and I was wondering if anyone here might be able to help me?  Here is a link to my question:  http://stackoverflow.com/questions/31814037/integrating-time-series-graphs-and-leaflet-maps-using-r-shiny.  Basically I am trying to link the data selected using leaflet and/ time series graphs (e.g., dygraphs), but not sure if/how this can be done using Shiny?  Thanks in advance for any help/suggestions. 

Kevin
